name: Button
usage: Primary action of a page header, form submission, confirming a dialog

props.name: variant
props.description:
Appearance: `primary` for the main action (solid accent color, at most one per area), `default` for
secondary actions (neutral fill), `dashed` for adding something to a list, `text` for a neutral text button
(a background appears on hover). For accent-colored text links, use LinkButton.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color: `danger` for destructive actions such as deleting; combine it with any `variant`.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Icon before the text: a name, or an icon component such as Lucide's `Plus` (like IconButton, LinkButton and
menu items); its size follows `size`. For a button with only an icon, use IconButton.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading indicator and ignores clicks; the width stays the same.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: type
props.description:
Native button type: `submit` submits the enclosing form, `reset` resets it. The default is `button`, which
does neither (unlike a bare `<button>`).

props.name: href
props.description: Turns the button into a link to this address (rendered as `<a>`).

props.name: target
props.description: Where the link opens, such as `_blank`; only with `href`.

props.name: download
props.description: Downloads the linked file instead of opening it; a string sets the file name. Only with `href`.

props.name: rel
props.description:
Relationship of the linked page, such as `nofollow`; only with `href`. With `target="_blank"` and no `rel`,
the button sets `noopener noreferrer`, so the opened page cannot reach this one through `window.opener`.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description:
Disabled reason: an explanation shown on hover or keyboard focus while `disabled`, such as "You don't have
permission to delete" or "Select a file first". With a reason, the button can still be focused with `Tab`
(`aria-disabled`) and screen readers read the reason through `aria-describedby`; clicks, `Enter`, form
submission (`type="submit"`) and link navigation have no effect.

types.name: IconName
types.summary:
Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`. Props that take an
icon also accept an icon component instead of a name (see IconComponent).

types.name: IconComponent
types.summary:
An icon component, such as Lucide's `Plus` (`import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'`), accepted wherever an icon name
is: `<Button icon={Plus}>`, `<Icon icon={Plus} />`, menu items and so on. Names (`icon="plus"`) are convenient
and work in data such as menu configurations, but cover only the registered icons (`iconNames`); a component can
be any Lucide icon, or an SVG of your own. Both are drawn with the same size, stroke width and `tone`.

types.name: IconComponentProps
types.summary:
Props that Icon passes to an icon component. Lucide icons (`import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'`) accept them; a
component of another icon set, or an SVG of your own, works too if it accepts them, or passes them on to its
`<svg>`.

fields.name: strokeWidth
fields.description:
Stroke width in the units of a 24 × 24 view box, already scaled for `size`: the line is 1.75 px wide on screen
by default, whatever the size.

fields.name: color
fields.description:
Stroke color: `currentColor` (the text color) or a semantic color variable, such as
`var(--vl-color-danger)`.

fields.name: aria-hidden
fields.description: `true` for a decorative icon (hidden from screen readers).

fields.name: aria-label
fields.description: Accessible name of a meaningful icon.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: At most one primary button per area; add `tone="danger"` for destructive actions.

examples.name: States
examples.title: Loading and disabled
examples.description:
Show `loading` while submitting to prevent double submission. The width does not change while loading: a button
with an icon replaces the icon with the loading indicator; a button without one hides its text and centers the
indicator.

examples.name: LoadOnClick
examples.title: Loading after a click
examples.description:
Clicks are ignored while loading and the width of the button stays the same, so the content next to it does not
move.

examples.name: DisabledReason
examples.title: Disabled reason
examples.description:
When a button is disabled because of permissions or unmet conditions, explain why with `disabledReason`: it
appears on hover or keyboard focus, and screen readers read it too.
